about: National Minimum Wage and National Living Wage hourly rates, for tools/build-minimum-wage-pages.js, quoted from GOV.UK. Each set applies from its start date; the page picks the set in force on the visitor's date.

ages.quote: You must be at least: school leaving age to get the National Minimum Wage; aged 21 to get the National Living Wage - the minimum wage will still apply for workers aged 20 and under

april.quote: The rates change on 1 April every year.

apprentice.quote: Apprentices are entitled to the apprentice rate if they’re either: aged under 19; aged 19 or over and in the first year of their apprenticeship … Apprentices are entitled to the minimum wage for their age if they both: are aged 19 or over; have completed the first year of their apprenticeship

acas.quote: Contact Acas if you’re not getting the National Minimum Wage and think you should be.

sources.title: National Minimum Wage and National Living Wage rates
